prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right choice depends on what you need (digital vs. branding vs. PR), your industry, budget, target customers, and whether you want a local partner or a firm that works remotely. I can help find the best fit for you — but first a few quick points to narrow it down and evaluate candidates.

Questions for you
- What type of marketing do you need? (digital ads, SEO, social media, content, branding, PR, B2B demand gen, ecommerce, etc.)
- Industry or audience (healthcare, tech, nonprofits, local retail, professional services)?
- Annual budget or monthly retainer range?
- Preferred location (Baltimore area, anywhere in Maryland, or remote OK)?
- Do you need full-service or a specialist?

How to evaluate agencies (fast checklist)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, revenue).
- Experience with your industry or similar business size.
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence.
- Client references and online reviews (Clutch, Google, UpCity).
- Team composition (strategy, creatives, analytics) and access level.
- Pricing model and contract flexibility.

Where I’ll look to find top candidates
- Clutch.co and UpCity (agency directories with reviews)
- Local “Best of” awards (Baltimore Business Journal, MD Tech Council)
- Portfolios and client case studies on agency websites
- LinkedIn and Google reviews

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll compile a tailored short‑list of 4–6 highly rated Maryland agencies (with specialties, estimated pricing, and suggested interview questions) within a day. Which details should I use?
